name: Inventory Discrepancy
description: WMS stock count does not match physical pick-bin quantity. The AI recommends proceeding based on system data; the human must decide whether to trust the count, verify, or pull from reserve.

entity_patches._note: Simulates ~17% pick-bin shrinkage discovered at cycle count (baseline 120 -> 100)

WH_1.current_inventory_note: Count accuracy in question; system shows available stock but physical verification may differ

weather_fallback: No weather dependency. This scenario is internal warehouse operations only.
difficulty_notes: Key decision factor: age of last count and historical variance rate. Low-variance fresh counts favour AI approval.
_notes: Weather coordinates unavailable; fallback-only mode used
entity_patches is the authoritative delta source; variable_changes is narrative context only
